subject: Next steps: SOC2 readiness, retention alignment & pen-test timeline
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@rivervault.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: SOC2 readiness, retention alignment & pen-test timeline

Hi Elaine — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Key pain points you called out
- Audit log retention and queryability across request/response traces (need 90+ days of immutable logs)
- DPA and data residency clauses that must align with your procurement template
- Pen-test window: vendor requires a 4-week testing window and evidence of prior patch/testing cadence
- Need to understand which parts of our hosted API traffic fall under your CDE vs non-CDE classification

Success criteria for RiverVault
- SOC2 artifacts covering system operation and logging controls (at least the snapshot of control mappings)
- Sample audit logs that demonstrate retention and tamper-evidence for a 90-day period
- Draft DPA with redlines addressed within two weeks to keep procurement on target for EoQ
- Confirm pen-test window and owner so we can schedule Dedicated environment snapshot if needed

What we (Redwood) will provide this week
- SOC2 controls snapshot (summary PDF) — attachment: redwood_soc2_snapshot_2026.pdf
- Sample audit log export (anonymized) — attachment: audit_log_samples_2026-09.csv
- Initial DPA draft for RiverVault — attachment: dpa_draft_rivervault_v1.docx
- Link to a short readiness checklist & proposed timeline (Drive link below)

Asks for RiverVault
- Confirm the 90-day retention requirement is the right scope (legal often wants to escalate to 180d in rare cases)
- Share your procurement timeline and the correct contact for DPA redlines (I think it’s legal@rivervault.com?).
- Confirm preferred pen-test window (tentative: Nov 9–Dec 4) and whether you require a clean-room snapshot or can test against a staging mirror.

Next steps
1) Elaine — please reply with confirmation on the retention duration and pen-test window.
2) Michael/Karthik — we’ll sequence the evidence handoff and create a short JIRA for artifacts and owners.
3) I’ll send a calendar invite for a 30-min follow-up once we have DPA owner and pen-test dates.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@rivervault.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: security@rivervault.com
Date: 2026-09-28T18:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: SOC2 readiness, retention alignment & pen-test timeline

Stephanie — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick confirmations and asks from our side: 

Confirmations
- 90 days is our minimum requirement for audit logs; procurement/legal may request 180 days but we can treat 90d as the baseline for technical acceptance.
- Pen-test window: Nov 15–Dec 3 would be ideal for vendor availability. We prefer a staging mirror if you can provide it; otherwise we need a dedicated snapshot and an agreed rollback plan.

Requests
- Can you include an example of the tamper-evidence or chain-of-custody metadata you store with logs (hashes, signatures, S3 object versioning)?
- We need a DPA that has your standard Redwoods Data Processing definitions — we will send a marked copy back within 5 business days. Please highlight any clauses where you cannot accept changes.
- Procurement timeline: target to finish contract redlines by 2026-10-22 to make the EoQ procurement cut. If that slips, we’ll escalate to category manager.

If you can provide the artifacts and a short meeting next week to walk through the log samples, that would be great.

Thanks — Elaine

—
Elaine Park
Head of Security, RiverVault
elaine.park@rivervault.com | +1 212-555-0142
From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: SOC2 readiness, retention alignment & pen-test timeline

Looping in operational owners and recommended sequencing. Owners / immediate plan: 

- Evidence package owner: Michael Grant (I’ll assemble SOC2 snapshot, artifact index, and the audit log samples into a zipped evidence bundle).
- Log export and retention verification: Karthik Iyer — please run the query for the anonymized 90-day sample and include object hashes/versioning metadata (S3 version id column).
- DPA ownership: Stephanie to lead external negotiation; legal@redwood will be on standby for redlines.

I’ll create JIRA RED-847 with subtasks: collect SOC2 artifact PDFs, audit log samples, retention proof (S3 lifecycle + object versions), and pen-test readiness checklist. ETA: evidence bundle by 2026-09-30 EOD.

Karthik — can you confirm estimated time to produce the anonymized export and whether we need any infra support to snapshot a staging mirror for the pen-test?

—
Michael Grant
Head of Reliability Engineering, Redwood Inference
michael@redwood.com

Elaine — following up with the artifacts we discussed. See links and attachments below; I’ve also included a short note on each file. Quoting your last message below for context.

Attachments (zipped bundle also available on Drive)
- redwood_soc2_snapshot_2026.pdf — control mappings, scope, and recent assessment dates
- audit_log_samples_2026-09.csv — anonymized rows + s3_version_id and sha256_hash columns included
- dpa_draft_rivervault_v1.docx — our starting DPA; please redline and send back 

Drive link for the evidence bundle: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleDriveLink
DPA review (optional e-sign): https://docusign.com/embeddedSigning/example
Related JIRA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-847

Summary of next steps & owners
- RiverVault to confirm retention window (Elaine) — please respond to this thread by EoD 2026-10-06 if 90d baseline is acceptable or if you want to target 180d.
- Redwood to produce full evidence bundle (Michael) — ETA 2026-09-30 EOD (in Drive).
- DPA redlines (RiverVault Legal) — expect marked copy by 2026-10-05. Stephanie to reconcile.
- Pen-test scheduling (ops + security) — Karthik to confirm feasibility of a staging mirror; tentatively Nov 15–Dec 3 per RiverVault preference.

I’ve scheduled a 30-min sync for 2026-10-07 09:00 PT to walk through the audit log sample and DPA questions — calendar invite on its way. If that time doesn’t work, I’ll adjust.

Thanks again. I’ll close the loop once the zipped bundle is live.
